subject.title: [Bug]: GitHub Copilot anthropic-messages transport silently hangs ~365s in isolated cron sessions (2026.5.27)

question: Should aborted or no-output GitHub Copilot Claude cron runs be eligible for model fallback after current-main live proof, or should OpenClaw stop at shorter idle timeout plus cron error status?
rationale: The remaining choice affects provider retry semantics and can repeat side effects if a tool or outbound operation occurred before the abort; source inspection cannot choose that policy safely.

options.title: Prove first, fallback narrowly
options.body: Run live Copilot cron proof and allow fallback only when the failed attempt has no committed tool or outbound side effects.

options.title: Fallback on aborted no-output
options.body: Classify aborted/no-output Copilot results as retryable whenever no visible assistant output was produced.

options.title: Surface error only
options.body: Keep the current shorter idle timeout and cron error status without adding aborted-result fallback.

recommendation.title: Prove first, fallback narrowly
recommendation.body: Run live Copilot cron proof and allow fallback only when the failed attempt has no committed tool or outbound side effects.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest identified routing candidate for Copilot Claude transport and provider stream policy.
